title: Exhibit a cheaper legal join than the least R439 frame closure

body:
PR2428 asks whether its least forced frame assignment is cost-minimal on the legal PR1868 fixture. One explicit raised join answers no: at A[591]=[266,243,[244]], use original rank-four frame 266 instead of the least rank-three join, then propagate the forced closure. Three roles merge their rank increments, giving exact profile delta -4 C1 -C2 +2 C3 and strict saving 4+2^p-2*3^p for every 0<p<1.

The complete 11,499-ADD scalar fixture, all 661 arbitrary dirty columns (forward/reverse), every final frame and all 9 exact rank-seven COPY spans are preserved. The new profile has 3019 children and mass 5129. It still costs more than the original source-frame profile; no optimum, native admission, supplier gain or kappa is claimed. This supplies the concrete join witness and validation that the predecessor requested, without repeating its exclusions.

CPython3.12.14 registered optimized replay passes. Rational ranks agree with modular ranks on every encountered span; four semantic controls, Git-free relocation and three actual source/receipt/join corruption checks pass. The prescribed PR1062 baseline passes 661 columns / 8 controls. Separate AI proof review found no actionable issue; hosted CI and independent human review are not claimed.

Current main 0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2 and PR2428 head b44ede42e5e90dedf311362f4ff23ec46b9b70c1 rechecked unchanged. Priority revision 4, explicit bit-helper-contract refinement from the recorded bit-mechanisms draw. Complete overlap cache: 710 PRs / 1207 Discussion records from 13:14-13:17UTC checked exact mechanism terms with no warnings. Only research/r439-coalesced-legal-join is added.
